character.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent character illustration for Caffeine Desktop settings app. Reference Image 1 is the character and artistic style reference. Create the SAME charming adult woman with long straight mocha brown hair, cream hair highlights, simple large black oval eyes, delicate golden cheek hatching, cream frilled collar, beige coat and slate blue-gray pleated dress. Change her pose to a relaxed upright waist-up three-quarter portrait: holding a warm ivory ceramic mug filled with coffee with both hands, lifted to her lips as she lightly sips, calm happy expression and two delicate steam wisps. Preserve the reference's loose elegant black hand-drawn linework and flat warm neutral colors, lightly imperfect sketch charm. Centered complete head, hair, shoulders, forearms and mug with generous transparent margin, compact composition readable at 200 pixels tall. Fully transparent background, no backdrop, no paper texture outside the subject, no square panel, no text, no watermark, no extra objects.

icon.initial_prompt: Use case: logo-brand / identity-preserve. Create ONE square 1024x1024 transparent PNG Windows app icon by converting the woman in the supplied image into a minimalist flat 2D bot-face avatar. Image 1 is the ONLY SUBJECT identity reference. Follow the gen-bot-face skill precisely: Huge rounded smooth cream face, exactly TWO identical solid #111111 black capsule eyes. Each eye has straight sides and semicircular ends, length 2.7 times its width; length about 0.19 of face width; center separation 0.38 of face width. Both eyes completely visible, no internal detail, no outlines. Rotate the whole head AND both parallel eyes together 18 degrees clockwise, with viewer-left eye higher and viewer-right eye lower. NO mouth, NO nose, NO eyebrows, NO lashes, NO lids, NO glints, NO eye outlines. Two small muted warm beige-pink flat oval blushes outside/below eyes. EXTREME close up peeking from bottom-left, face spans 85-95% of canvas width, deliberately cropped at left and bottom, transparent negative space in top-right. Preserve this woman's source-specific long mocha-brown hair, asymmetric parted bangs and characteristic broad cream-colored hair highlight, using several overlapping broad flat shapes in neighboring mocha/taupe colors. Retain long tapered side locks and layered fringe instead of a generic bob. No hair outline or interior sketch lines. No new accessories. Omit body and hands, at most a tiny cream frilled collar in bottom 10%. Minimal smooth flat color blocks, no gradients, no gloss, no paper texture, no black outlines anywhere except the eyes themselves. No coffee mug or other props in the icon. No text, logo, numbers, frames, rounded-square background, border, sparkles. Background MUST be real transparency, not charcoal, checkerboard or solid fill. Distinctive source silhouette and the two plain capsule eyes must remain legible at 32px.

tray_icon.initial_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: preview-only proposed Windows system tray icon for Caffeine Desktop. Primary request: design a beautifully simple, highly legible COFFEE MUG icon, intended ultimately for 16–24 pixel tray use. Single large centered cream ceramic mug filled with dark espresso, viewed almost front-on with a slight view into its wide dark oval coffee surface. One generous D-shaped handle on the right with a clear open center; one short thick gentle S steam wisp above the coffee. Use extremely simplified bold flat geometric shapes, an elegant friendly subtly rounded silhouette, thick smooth dark mocha outlines. Mug body warm ivory #FFFCF6, coffee deep espresso #302C29, small solid warm mocha #79573E shape along lower mug edge for depth. The steam has a cream core and mocha keyline so it can be read on light and dark backgrounds. Composition: icon fills roughly 85% of square, balanced optical center with handle included, compact steam, clear negative spaces. Production-minded small-icon geometry with chunky details that survive reduction; plain unmarked cup, no face, no eyes, no robot, no letters, no beans, no saucer, no badge, no enclosing tile or circle, no extra objects. Style: crisp premium flat icon, no photorealism, no 3D, no gradients, no blurry edges, no drop shadows, no cast shadows, no glow, no tiny ornament. Background MUST be true transparent alpha, not a painted checkerboard. Make only one icon, no presentation board and no text.
tray_icon.edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied coffee mug tray icon. Refine this icon into genuinely FLAT, pixel-size-readable logo geometry. Preserve the cream cup, espresso-brown coffee oval, right open handle, and friendly rounded silhouette. Make only these simplifications: remove ALL shadows, halos, lighting, texture, gradients, beveling and 3D appearance; every region must be one perfectly uniform opaque solid color. Outside the hard icon silhouette and inside the handle hole there must be absolutely empty transparency, alpha=0, with NO surrounding smoky pixels or shadow. Use just cream #FFFCF6, espresso #302C29 for all outlines and coffee, and a very small flat mocha #79573E lower accent. Shorten the steam wisp to 15% of the whole icon height and use a compact thick cream S stroke outlined espresso. Make mug and handle occupy 75% of icon height. Use a bold dark contour roughly 8% of mug body width, with thick compact handle and clear hole. Keep generous 8% transparent canvas margin. The result should look like a clean simple flat vector pictogram for 16-pixel system tray use, not a physical object or rendered 3D emoji. One icon only, no text, no grid, no checkerboard, no presentation background.
